title: 2026-11-11 live catalogue reconciliation: Gopher resolver versus MCP ownership
summary: A standalone LLM Gopher sphere resolution does not register its sphere as a first-class project component. The 2026-11-11 Rasen Falcon live MCP catalogue listed 137 runtime components, zero sphere components, and older/missing source-provenance metadata, while direct sphere resolution succeeded. Do not deploy the older MCP dev8 82-runtime/53-sphere snapshot over the live 137 runtime components.

facts.operation: 2026-11-11 second read: live component namespace compared with historical source
facts.result: Live 138 distinct logical project components. Historical MCP dev8 runtime source has 82 artifact entries representing 77 distinct artifact component IDs. Only three canonical IDs match: oorexx_native_database_backends, llm_gopher, nosqlserver. The 135 new logical IDs and 74 historical-only artifact IDs are different identity models; concatenation is not a safe migration.

invariants: The MCP runtime catalog is a sealed, accepted source snapshot. Do not rebuild project authority dynamically from arbitrary Gopher files during live MCP calls.
The live 137 runtime component IDs and their aliases must be preserved before adding sphere: identities; older 82-runtime fixture must fail closed.
Runtime component and sphere component ownership are independent. An unbound sphere.check result grants no project ownership or mailbox access.
McpProjectNullSphereChecker is the default when the service does not inject its own Gopher checker; a separate sphere transport can still work.
Do not expose the Operator Desk /spheres as an empty world when catalogue read is unconfigured; signal unavailability, preserve signed-in principal and source provenance.
Source candidate and simulated checks are not native r13196 MCP acceptance, host installation, operator admission or service restart.

migration_rule: Reconcile current, explicitly accepted logical project component IDs and aliases before projecting Gopher sphere components. Do not treat historical package artifact component IDs as a substitute for current project lanes. Do not bypass the no-loss gate simply because the input arrays have different schema versions. The runtime authority owner must attest the canonical live source.
